parts.text: When crystals of hydrated calcium ethanedioate, CaC 2 O 4 •H 2 O, are heated they decompose to form solid calcium carbonate, steam and carbon monoxide gas. CaC 2 O 4 •H 2 O(s) → CaCO 3 (s) + H 2 O(g) + CO(g) A student suggests using the apparatus shown in Fig. 1.1 to decompose hydrated calcium ethanedioate and obtain the products.
